snippet.title: zozyblue
snippet.description:
Zozyblue - Is a music promotion channel in video clips of our partner labels specialized in electronic music. 
That's why we support and promote with video clips our artists signed to our partner labels: Sub. Mission Recordings, Ultima Audio, Skyline Digital, Your Melodies, Endlessky Audio, High Emotions Recordings, Interplay Records, Sounds Of The Stars Recordings, InZearZ, High Reshive, Abora Olé, Tar#138 Records, Liquid Energy Digital, 2Rock Recordings, Alternative Emotions, Phoenix Recordings, En Un Mundo Sin Ti, SounEmot Records, TAR Oasis, InZearZ, Interplay Global, Trance Is The Life Recordings, Digital Euphoria Recordings, Illusion Vibes, Our Shared Emotions, Abora Recordings, Lifting Force Music, Abora Chillout and RekayWorz,

Our distribution of our partner labels works through popular internet stores such as Beatport, Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and many more stores. 

We work with many talented musicians, labels and producers around the world.
